m1-resolve-hooks-dir.imperative: Add resolve_git_hooks_dir(repo_root) -> Path | None to scripts/install_constellation.py: runs `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path hooks` with cwd=repo_root, returns None on any git failure (never raises), matching is_git_tracked's try/except(OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) + returncode style. Test-after is allowed; write the function then the tests. Attest c1 (TDD not required as test-after), verify c2 by running the new tests.

m2-install-hook.title: install_git_precommit_hook + write/idempotent/clobber/dry-run tests
m2-install-hook.imperative: Add install_git_precommit_hook(repo_root, dry_run, out) -> None: resolves hooks dir via resolve_git_hooks_dir, no-ops with a report if None; writes an executable shell wrapper at <hooks-dir>/pre-commit that resolves `<toplevel>` at RUN TIME via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` inside the wrapper (never an install-time-baked path) and execs `python3 <toplevel>/scripts/hooks/code_map_precommit.py`; embeds an idempotency marker comment; re-running with identical intended content is byte-identical; refuses (reports, does not raise or clobber) when a pre-existing pre-commit lacks the marker; chmod +x on write; honors dry_run (prints plan, writes nothing). Add tests: explicit wiring writes the executable wrapper referencing code_map_precommit.py; idempotent re-run is byte-identical; refuse-to-clobber leaves a foreign marker-less pre-commit untouched and reports the refusal; --dry-run writes nothing.

postconditions.statement: install_git_precommit_hook added; write/idempotent/refuse-clobber/dry-run tests all pass

m3-wire-main.title: wire main() params + __main__ + self-install-only guard
m3-wire-main.imperative: Add keyword-only main() params install_git_pre_commit_hook: bool = False, git_repo_root: Path | None = None, mirroring wire_repo_mcp_config/mcp_config_path's exact shape. Call install_git_precommit_hook at the same call site as apply_repo_mcp_config_wiring, guarded by `install_git_pre_commit_hook and (git_repo_root is not None or is_self_install(args))`, passing `git_repo_root if git_repo_root is not None else REPO_ROOT`. Add install_git_pre_commit_hook=True to the if __name__ == "__main__": block alongside wire_repo_mcp_config=True. Zero changes to wire_hooks/HOOK_SETS/report_hook_wiring or any Claude Code PostToolUse/settings.json path. Add tests: default no-op (install_git_pre_commit_hook=False leaves a scratch repo's hooks untouched even when present); self-install-only case -- with install_git_pre_commit_hook=True, git_repo_root left at its None default, and args shaped so is_self_install(args) is False (e.g. --dest elsewhere), install_git_precommit_hook must never be invoked (assert via mock.patch.object spy, not by touching this real checkout's own .git/hooks).
